briefdescription.para: Converts the current color to a uint32_t representation.

detaileddescription.para: This function converts the current color into a 32-bit unsigned integer format, where each byte represents an RGBA component (Red, Green, Blue, Alpha). The conversion is done in such a way that if w > 0, then each of the four bytes will be in the range [0, 255]. If w <= 0, then all components are set to zero.

simplesect.para: A 32-bit unsigned integer representing the current color.
